_comment: User-editable settings. Edit values here — no need to touch Python code. Secrets go in .env, NOT here.

ui._layout_comment: Portrait mode for the Pi 7-inch screen in vertical orientation. Set portrait to false for landscape (small thumbnail instead of large preview).

conversation._comment: How long the robot stays in conversation mode after the person stops talking or leaves.
conversation._max_session_comment: Set max_session_seconds to a number (e.g. 300) to limit session length, or leave null for unlimited.

wave_detection._comment: Experimental wave-gesture detection. Set enabled to true to try it. The robot will greet someone who waves before they speak.
wave_detection._threshold_comment: motion_threshold: 0-255, higher = less sensitive. min_motion_frames: how many frames of motion before confirming a wave.
